title_html: How to Choose a 3PL for TikTok Shop: A Selection and Onboarding Checklist
description: Choosing a 3PL warehouse for TikTok Shop? Seven criteria to vet before you sign and a staged onboarding plan that protects your dispatch metrics from day one.
dek: You have decided on a 3PL. Now the contract decides whether your TikTok Shop account health holds up. Here are the seven things we vet before a brand signs, and the order we onboard in.
author: Jackie He
llms_summary: A selection and onboarding checklist for brands that have already chosen a 3PL for TikTok Shop: seven vetting criteria (order sync, cut-off times and holiday handling, dispatch reporting, sample kitting, returns, surge capacity, contract structure) plus a staged onboarding plan, anchored to TikTok's published 2-business-day dispatch SLA and account-health thresholds.
